chapter: Los Angeles, Ellington and the recording scene
title: Writing lyrics and "Primrose Lane"
summary: Callender has written lyrics since age eighteen and mentions his ASCAP rating and the song "Primrose Lane".

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: How long have you been writing lyrics?
Yeah, I have quite a few songs that I wrote the lyrics to. I have a pretty good ASCAP rating.
Some things you may never have heard. I didn't write the lyric to "Primrose Lane," I wrote the music, but that really saved my life more than once.
